dims_mm.note: Clamshell. Handheld footprint = closed footprint (project rule). AYANEO size: 180*102*29.3 mm, 35.7 mm at the grip.

ports.note: Both ports full-featured: DP 1.4, PD charging (65 W PD charger spec), data

screen.note: 315 PPI, 150% sRGB volume, 110% DCI-P3, 10-bit, 144/120/90/60 Hz steps, software (system-level) HDR. Stepless hinge to 180 degrees. Secondary screen: 4.5" 1620x1080 IPS, 3:2, 433 PPI, 550 nits; AYASpace offers a virtual keyboard and trackpad on it.

controls.stick_note: TMR electromagnetic medium-size joystick, 1000 Hz polling
controls.note: Optical finger mouse (not a trackpad). Dual 6-axis gyroscope. Dual-screen button and navigation button.

cooling: Vapor chamber + heat-sink fins with fan (air cooling); 30 W max TDP
notes: Launch price for 16GB + 1TB: early bird $799, retail $999. Pre-ordered on Indiegogo from 2025-07-10. In late December 2025 AYANEO said the 8840U supplier could not deliver for the foreseeable future and offered 8840U backers an exchange for an AYANEO 3 or a paid upgrade to the HX 370 model. No source confirms that any 8840U unit shipped. The AYANEO store lists only HX 370 configs. Status 'announced' means not shipped; the variant appears cancelled.
